fields.label: Area of work
fields.note: IBM 'Area of work' facet. Verified live: adding {"term":{"field_keyword_08":"Sales"}} to query.bool.filter narrowed 23 hits to 9.

fields.label: Work arrangement
fields.note: All 23 live postings are Hybrid, so the aggregation has a single bucket.

fields.label: Experience level
fields.note: Single observed bucket (Professional) across the live search.

notes: HashiCorp's own /en/careers page now redirects its 'Open positions' links to IBM's careers search (https://www.ibm.com/careers/search?q=hashicorp). The search UI calls POST https://www-api.ibm.com/search/api/v2 with appId=careers, scopes=[careers2], the keyword repeated in query.bool.must.simple_query_string.query and sm.query, page size 30, and reporting aggs for work arrangement (field_keyword_17), area of work (field_keyword_08), experience level (field_keyword_18) and location (field_keyword_05/19). Facets are applied as term filters inside the same JSON body, not as URL parameters; detail pages live on careers.ibm.com.
evidence: https://www.ibm.com/careers/search?q=hashicorp (HTTP 200) -> IBM careers search app, translations 'Most Relevant/Most Recent/Newest To Oldest'
